name: 個人会話の見出し
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup.
Edit Image 2, Lighthouse LH03-0001 conversation header candidate. Image 1 ORIGINAL WhatsApp header controls icon geometry, stroke/optical weight, spacing and fine anatomy; our mock Image 3 is secondary only for Japanese content and overall placement. Do not copy rough mock substitutes.
Targeted correction only: the generated video glyph is too square and the handset too generic. Match the ORIGINAL header video camera's low, horizontally rectangular rounded body with compact right-facing lens wedge, and the ORIGINAL telephone receiver silhouette, balanced slim black-line proportions adapted to slate #526173. Keep back chevron a clean familiar slender shape matching the original. Crisp outline strokes at uniform optical weight. No added symbols.
Keep all other design properties from Image 2: white canvas, one white rounded lightly outlined softly elevated header; white outlined avatar with green「山」; exact one-line name「山田 はるか」in Meiryo Bold logical14/24 tracking0. Preserve positions, compact sequence and existing white/forest-green/slate colors. The initial uses forest green to identify the person; no mint fill and no colored call-button background. Name and avatar remain unchanged.
Original screen content outside its top conversation header is irrelevant: do not add chat bubbles, photo, wallpaper, English, extra labels, title or device. One component only on landscape 3:1 pure white canvas.
reviewNotes: 最新の所有者指示により原画像をアイコン細部の最優先入力にして修正。日本語・全操作・白面・森林緑の頭文字・統一スレートを維持。実画像を目視。映像カメラの胴体は依然原画像より角張り正方形寄り、通話輪郭も一般化が残る。原画像との形状一致は未達。2回の試行を保持し、無限修正を避けて要修正として保留。v001のreviewedは旧基準の目視履歴で、現在の最終受入を意味しない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: primary original source: header glyph geometry and control anatomy
edit-target: existing generated candidate; preserve name/colors/composition
secondary component mock: Japanese content and logical placement only
